project_type: Vite 7 React 18 SPA with SSR prerendering, deployed on Cloudflare Pages
build_system: Vite 7 with custom build orchestrator (scripts/build.mjs), pnpm
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E
verification_instructions: 1. Run vite build to ensure no compilation errors. 2. Run vitest run to confirm unit tests pass. 3. Verify the built output does NOT contain jsxDEV references. 4. Confirm _headers file is in dist/ after build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/_headers is generated at build time by preload-headers-inject.js plugin which APPENDS to public/_headers. Manual headers go in public/_headers.
setup_instructions: cd apps/frontend && pnpm install (or npm install)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages from registries. Must use pre-installed tools and AST-level validation. Cannot run Docker.
contribution_requirements: Branch is perf/frontend-pagespeed-100. Changes target achieving 100/100 PageSpeed score on mobile for all four categories.
key_patterns: Vite plugins handle HTML transforms (backendPreconnectPlugin, cfAnalyticsPlugin, ga4Plugin). Security headers served via Cloudflare Pages _headers file. Skip link uses Tailwind sr-only/focus:not-sr-only pattern. The oxc config in vite.config.js handles JSX transformation.
directory_structure: apps/frontend/ - main frontend app. apps/frontend/public/ - static assets served by CF Pages. apps/frontend/src/ - React source. apps/frontend/vite-plugins/ - custom Vite plugins. apps/frontend/scripts/ - build scripts.
